Interface TaskService

All Known Implementing Classes:
TaskServiceImpl
public interface TaskService
============================================================================== Task Service (Business Logic Interface) ============================================================================== Defines the contract (public API) for task management business operations.

Key Concepts for Beginners:

  • Interface-Based Programming: In professional Java enterprise applications, we define an interface for the service contract and a separate implementation class (e.g., TaskServiceImpl). This provides:
    1. Loose coupling: Controllers depend on this interface, not the concrete implementation.
    2. Easy unit testing: In tests, you can easily mock this interface.
    3. Spring AOP support: Spring creates dynamic proxies around interfaces to handle cross-cutting concerns like @Transactional and security checks.

  • Method Details

    • getTasks

      org.springframework.data.domain.Page<TaskResponse> getTasks(TaskStatus status, String search, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Searches and lists tasks with optional filtering and pagination.
      Parameters:
      status - optional status filter (e.g. TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE)
      search - optional case-insensitive keyword to match in the title
      pageable - pagination parameters (page number, page size, sort order)
      Returns:
      a paginated page of task response DTOs

    • getTaskById

      TaskResponse getTaskById(Long id)
      Retrieves a single task by its database primary key ID.
      Parameters:
      id - the task's unique ID
      Returns:
      the task response DTO
      Throws:
      TaskNotFoundException - if no task matches the given ID

    • createTask

      TaskResponse createTask(CreateTaskRequest request)
      Creates a new task based on the provided request DTO.
      Parameters:
      request - validated input payload containing title, status, priority, etc.
      Returns:
      the newly persisted task response DTO with generated ID and timestamps

    • updateTask

      TaskResponse updateTask(Long id, UpdateTaskRequest request)
      Updates an existing task's fields.
      Parameters:
      id - the primary key ID of the task to update
      request - validated input payload with new values
      Returns:
      the updated task response DTO
      Throws:
